summary.text: Geoff Smith is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives who has represented Strafford 21 since December 2022 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Geoff Smith lives in Dover, New Hampshire, and earned a master's degree from Southern New Hampshire University.
He assumed office on December 7, 2022, and advanced from the Democratic primary for Strafford 21 on September 8, 2026.
